title: Embracing Celestial Angels
description: Two winged angels with glowing halos stand intimately embraced in the center, their heads touching and hands clasped together over a small bouquet. They wear ornate blue robes decorated with large orange spheres and have large feathered wings with fiery orange and pink gradients.
prompt: Two beautiful female angels with large white and orange feathered wings embrace intimately in the foreground, their foreheads touching and hands gently clasped together holding white flowers. They wear intricate blue and gold robes adorned with large glowing orange circular patterns and golden halos. Dramatic apocalyptic sunset sky with dark stormy clouds and golden light rays breaking through, ruined fantasy cityscape visible in the distant background, highly detailed cinematic fantasy painting.
